softwareInnerHero.title: World-Class Cyber Protection
paragraphs: Kaspersky is a globally recognized cybersecurity company with over 20 years of experience in protecting businesses and individuals from cyber threats. Our innovative solutions combine cutting-edge technology with expert knowledge to deliver comprehensive security.

From endpoint protection to advanced threat intelligence, Kaspersky provides a complete security ecosystem that adapts to the evolving threat landscape. Our solutions are trusted by over 400 million users and 270,000 corporate clients worldwide.

With a focus on research and development, Kaspersky continuously innovates to stay ahead of cybercriminals, providing you with the most effective protection against malware, ransomware, phishing, and other sophisticated attacks.
